_README: Accepted pre-existing type errors, per file. THIS IS A RATCHET, NOT AN EXEMPTION LIST:
a file may improve, never regress, and a file absent from here must have zero errors.
Regenerate after a genuine improvement with: npm run test:compile -- --update
Every entry below is owned by a named unit. Do not clear one by adding guards at call
sites - that is the pattern CLAUDE.md's escalation rule exists to prevent.
_ownership: RESOLVED BY DELETION — Phase 1.6 purge, 2026-07-25. 12 baseline entries are gone
because their owning FILE is gone, not because anyone fixed a type error:
All were unreachable from App.tsx and from every test/dev entry point. Recorded
here so a future reader does not mistake a deletion for a fix, and so the
product count dropping 63 -> 38 is attributable rather than mysterious.
